privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This document is an initial draft meant to accompany {siteName}'s app store launch, and doesn't replace a legal review. Before publishing the app, replace the support contact below with a real one you can monitor.
privacy.dataAccount: email (or a synthetic email if you sign in with Steam), username, display name, profile picture and bio if you fill it in.
privacy.dataOAuth: if you sign in with Google or Steam, we receive that account's identifier, your name and your public profile picture — never your password.
privacy.dataContent: lineups, boosts, plays, guides, comments, ratings and reports you publish.
privacy.dataUsage: aggregated, anonymous performance and navigation metrics (Vercel Analytics / Speed Insights), with no advertising tracking cookies or selling data to third parties.
privacy.purposeBody: To run your account and session (strictly necessary authentication cookies), show your content and public profile, calculate XP/level/achievements, moderate the platform (reports, bans), and understand which pages work best to prioritize improvements.
privacy.sharingBody: With our infrastructure providers — Supabase (database and authentication) and Vercel (hosting and analytics) — only to run the service. We don't sell personal data to third parties or use it for advertising.
privacy.rightsBodyBefore: You can edit your profile at any time, and permanently delete your account and personal data (likes, favorites, comments, ratings) from
privacy.rightsBodyAfter: . Content you published (lineups, boosts, plays, guides) stays on the platform without your name, just like any other community content.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data: replace this with a real support email before publishing to app stores.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: This document is an initial draft meant to accompany {siteName}'s app store launch, and doesn't replace a legal review.
terms.serviceBody: {siteName} is a Counter-Strike 2 learning hub made by the community. Public use with no account required; an account is optional to publish, rate, comment and save content.
terms.contentBody: You're responsible for the content you publish (lineups, boosts, plays, guides, comments). Don't publish offensive content, content that infringes someone else's copyright, spam or false information — a moderator or admin can remove it or suspend your account if you do. Any user can report content that violates this from its detail page.
terms.accountsBodyBefore: You're responsible for keeping your session secure. You can delete your account at any time from Settings; see the
terms.accountsBodyAfter: for details on what happens to your data and content when you do.
terms.availabilityBody: The service is offered "as is", with no guarantee of continuous availability. Content is generated by the community and may contain errors — try any lineup or strategy at your own judgment.
